reason: I earn about ₹48,000 a month from my job and my channel brings in little or nothing, so ₹299 a month is a real cut into my budget for a tool I have never paid for. I can already get YouTube Studio, vidIQ and TubeBuddy for free and ask ChatGPT for title ideas.
objection: I cannot yet see that Mitra's weekly suggestions will beat what I already do for free, and until my channel earns, paying ₹299 a month for advice is hard to justify.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing proof on my own channel that Mitra's suggestions beat my usual views, or a free tier that is useful enough on its own to show that before I pay.
